t: You're at Euston tube station, which sits directly beneath the National Rail station of the same name, in London fare zone 1. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for the stations he created for the London Underground in the first decade of the twentieth century. Look for his trademark style: oxblood red glazed faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular windows on the first floor, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style. Green died in 1908, aged thirty-three.
